summary: Sephardic Alliance discusses the custom of the aryat during the shivah period, where hahamim read Zohar and Tehilim to elevate the neshama of the deceased. The class details the daily readings, the books used, the speeches given by hahamim, and how the practice concludes.
questions: What is the aryat during a shivah?
Which books were traditionally read by the hahamim during the mourning period?
How has the practice of reading Zohar changed over time?
What role do the speeches by hahamim play at the end of the week?
When is the aryat concluded according to the custom?
